checks: Exact p=0 and p=1 success and return matched direct endpoint kernels for every seed and mode.
Pre-overwrite deterministic histories matched between fixed and always-fire kernels.
Pinned source and adapted p=0.05 results were reproduced.
Independent Decimal recomputation differed by at most 2.4459506622476507740756797834605394E-16.
All five seeds and every failed fixed-kernel path were retained.

mathematics.assertion_tested: For each frozen deterministic execution mode on 5 learner seeds x 32 natural starts, recompute exact expected success and discounted return at overwrite probabilities 0, 0.05, 0.30, and 1 from the recorded fixed-kernel paths.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Decimal arithmetic at 50 digits for the independent aggregate; binary64/JAX values in the recorded run.
mathematics.conventions: Discount 0.995; terminal success reward represented by 0.995^(T-1); independent overwrite survival (1-p)^k; one physical grain loss makes the three-grain goal impossible.
non_claims: The oracle switch is not autonomous defect detection.
The result does not prove that earlier learned switching would fail.
The exact p=0.05 and p=0.30 values are finite-panel expectations from deterministic fixed paths, not fresh stochastic rollouts.
Five Dual-history learner seeds do not establish a population frequency or significance result.

residual_risks: The policy network and simulator implementation were not independently reimplemented.
The intermediate-probability result relies on the proved-by-environment property that any overwrite loss makes the delivery goal impossible.
Schema version 1 does not machine-verify the external RAID input paths.
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated five-seed, 32-start panel.
